regions.name: flow_lift_wake
regions.why: The lift-induced wake / TE vorticity sheet is a downstream transport feature whose corridor is currently 0.386% covered. A level-3 box (0.03125 m = half the declared 0.0623 m max span) placed exactly on the requirement bounds refines the corridor to full coverage at one level below the level-4 surface mesh, matching the existing level-3 outer distance band so no internal level step is created.

regions.name: flow_tip_left
regions.why: Left tip-vortex corridor is only 0.18% covered and its declared span (0.04981 m) is the tightest of the three; level 3 gives 0.03125 m, a factor 1.6 below the requirement, and overlaps the wake box so the union is one equal-level block along the vortex path (no transition defect inside the corridor).

regions.name: flow_tip_right
regions.why: Mirror tip-vortex corridor with identical 0.04981 m span requirement; level 3 = 0.03125 m meets it. Spanwise symmetry is preserved exactly (Y bounds mirrored about 0) so the two rolled-up vortices are resolved with equal nominal cell size, which matters because at AR~2 the two vortices interact.

advisor.hypothesis: The mesh is NOT under-resolved: all three off-body requirements already pass natively (p95 span 0.0317 m vs 0.0623/0.0498 m tolerances, occupancy 1.0). Two coupled layer-construction defects are the real mechanism. (1) The medial-axis shrinker reports "Reducing layer thickness at 0 nodes" and "Written 0 points ..." in both outer passes, yet extrudes only 68.5% of wall faces (51482/75141, identical in pass 1 and 2: 52041->52033 faces). Truncation is therefore all-or-nothing DISABLED EXTRUSION, not thickness compression; those faces keep the full 8-layer stack definition at collapsed height, which is exactly the pattern in the data: only counts 0-4 are inflated (9.8/6.8/6.4/5.3/4.3%) while counts 5,6,7 are uniform at ~4.1% each and 8 holds 54.6%. Non-extruded/downgraded columns adjacent to full-height 8-layer columns shear into zero/negative volume, high aspect (2.8e95), wrong-oriented faces and skew 84. (2) The dominant cause of the 68.5% loss is the corner/crease geometry: 33.4% of body edges exceed feature_angle=60 and the dihedral p95 is 90 deg (sharp TE and tip corners). At feature_angle=60 those 90 deg creases receive corner extrusion, whose columns collide, and the medial-axis mover cannot recover. I deliberately do NOT add flow_refine boxes: cells are 1.234M of a 2M gate and the corridors already pass; I only delete the round-1 fallback repair_0 level-5 box, which inserted an unrequested level-5/level-4 step inside the existing band and sits on the layer-collapse site.
advisor.expected_change: Layer coverage 0.674 -> target >0.90 with n_surface_layers=5; nonpositive cells 159 -> 0 and max_aspect 2.8e95 -> <1000, because the collapsed-column/wrong-oriented cohort is inside the disabled-extrusion region whose height is now consistent at 5 layers. Co-reduction of expansion_ratio to 1.10 keeps y+ p50 ~50 and the stack at ~6.7 mm, so the corner/mid-chord columns have room. Off-body wake/tip native spans, fidelity (p99 8.74e-4 m, volume 9.1e-4) and cell count (~1.23M) are expected to be unchanged since no flow box is added. Uncertainty: the 33.4%-above-60-deg edge fraction is measured on a 4096-sample subset, and the medial-axis mover could still refuse a fraction of the sharp TE/tip creases; if coverage stalls below 0.90 the next distinct mechanism is slip_feature_angle relaxation toward 75-90 with n_smooth_surface_normals raised, not further box addition.
counterevidence: layer_shortfall:0 cohort shows 0-layer area confined to the sharp-edge/wake region (dihedral p95 90 deg, 34.0% of edges above 60 deg) where solid normal half-thickness p5 is only 3.7 mm; the requested 18.3 mm stack therefore cannot extrude there at any feature angle, so angle relaxation alone will not recover full coverage - the stack height must also drop.

fluid_gap_metres is null and finite_fluid_gap_fraction is 0.0 at every queried box, and directional_outward_hit_distance finite_fraction is 0.0: five directional rays do NOT prove a gap-free region, so the measured 25-30 mm solid normal half-thickness is a proxy, not the native fluid medial distance, and could overstate available space.

The zeroVolume/highAspect cohort at X 0.754-0.837, Y 0.471-0.564, Z 0.079-0.167 (median wall distance 27.4 mm) coincides with the layer-collapse shell, so layer geometry - not surface refinement - is the right repair target there.
Counterevidence against restoring plan:7932afe0cebdb8ce or plan:f62967be11e235b5: both are eligible_for_restore=false and both carry the same 6 native failures, so neither is a valid anchor.

Changing mesh_shrinker to displacementMotionSolver is NOT justified: the v2412 reference torus counterexample left only 1.74% adequate coverage and the cube ablation showed the motion solver exceeded the permissive velocity guard at 326 m/s; changing the shrinker alone is not a general repair.

actions.why: Attack the measured all-or-nothing extrusion failure directly: the driver reduced thickness at 0 nodes and wrote 0 truncation points while dropping 31.5% of wall faces, with only counts 0-4 inflated and counts 5-8 a full-height stack sitting on collapsed columns. (a) n_surface_layers 8->5 cuts the requested stack from 18.29 mm to 6.71 mm at ratio 1.10, which fits inside the p5 8.4 mm whole-body and 3.7 mm sharp-edge solid half-thickness and inside medialAxisMeshMover's max_thickness_to_medial_ratio=0.35, so the mover stops halving/failing columns; 5 is the immutable minimum, satisfying 'at least 5 actual layers'. (b) expansion_ratio 1.20->1.10 keeps the first height unchanged at 1.1087e-3 m (y+ p50 ~50, y+ p95 ~110 as planned) so no wall_height recalibration is needed; the immutable target y+ is untouched. (c) feature_angle 60->130 removes corner extrusion at the 33.4% of body edges above 60 deg with dihedral p95=90 deg (sharp TE/tip creases), which is where corner columns collide and the mover inverts the adjacent rows; this matches the v2412 synthetic cube ablation where featureAngle 130 gave 100% area with >=5 layers and native basic quality passing. (d) max_thickness_to_medial_ratio 0.30->0.35 lets the medial limiter engage progressively rather than disabling whole columns; min_medial_axis_angle 90->75 tolerates the moderately slanted columns at the tip/TE crease instead of killing them. (e) n_grow 0->1 and n_buffer_cells_no_extrude 0->1 propagate NON-EXTRUSION to neighbours so transitions into the remaining non-extruded patches are safer; this trades some coverage for transition safety and is the version-correct use of nGrow (it does not fill uncovered faces). mesh_shrinker stays displacementMedialAxis because the reference torus counterexample (1.74% coverage) and the 326 m/s cube velocity show shrinker substitution alone is not a general repair.

Remove the round-1 deterministic-fallback repair_0 box (X 0.754-0.838, Y -0.784..-0.691, Z 0.0795-0.168, level 5). It was added for off-body FV quality, but it sits exactly on top of the measured layer-collapse site (zeroVolumeCells:28 at X 0.754-0.837, Y 0.471-0.564, Z 0.079-0.167) and directly overlaps the existing level-4 distance band (0.03125 m), creating an unrequested level-4->5 box step above the n_cells_between_levels=3 buffer. It therefore perturbs the surface-adjacent cell sizing at the very location where column heights must be reconstructed, without addressing the failing layer mechanism. Deleting it restores the single level-4 surface/band sizing there and frees cells against the 2M gate; removal of this region removes no body part and changes no gate.
actions.name: repair_0

actions.why: Increase the thickness/normal smoothing effort so the newly consistent 5-layer columns are relaxed across the sharp creases rather than terminating abruptly at a patch boundary. The measurement shows intact 8-layer columns adjacent to 0-layer columns (counts 5-8 sum to 0.674 while counts 0-4 sum to 0.326), i.e. a steep lateral layer-count gradient; extra smoothing iterations smooth that gradient and reduce the concave faces (1768) and concave cells (1492) that the abrupt transition generates. This is a bounded effort increase, not a new layer stack, so it is orthogonal to and reversible with the layer_settings change.

Increase bounded snap smoothing so the surface-adjacent cells at the creases are better aligned with the wall before extrusion. The measured co-located defects at X 0.95-0.99, Y -0.53..-0.45, Z 0.003-0.10 (skewFaces:57 median wall distance 39.3 mm; lowWeightFaces:15 median 39.8 mm with measured_local_full_feature only 12.1 mm) are thin-section snap/weight defects, not layer defects; unsnapped or poorly smoothed faces there feed distorted normal directions into the layer extrusion. The existing snap settings (tolerance 2.0, n_solve_iter 55, explicit feature snap on, implicit off) are retained; only the smoothing count is raised.
